title: Planned maintenance at the St. Aldric's Road mast, Gullhaven
text: Planned maintenance: Kittiwake Mobile engineers will upgrade the mast at St. Aldric's Road, Gullhaven, on 14 October from 1 a.m. to approx. 5 a.m. Calls and data may drop during this window. Customers on Unlimited Plus won't be charged for Wi-Fi calling in the meantime. Questions? Text HELP to 2020 or visit kittiwake.example/status.

title: Flex 30 price change from 1 November
text: From 1 November the Flex 30 plan rises from $30.00 to $32.50 a month. Customers who joined before 1 Sept. keep their current price until their contract ends. Dr. Ines Varga, Kittiwake's head of pricing, said the change funds new 5G masts in Saltmoor and Port Ember.

title: Outage restored in Cragwell and Marrowby
text: Outage update, 3:40 p.m.: data services in Cragwell and Marrowby are restored. A fibre cut near Eastholm Quay caused the outage. Affected customers will receive a $5.00 credit on their next bill. We're sorry for the disruption.

title: Nimbus X2 update 4.2 paused
text: The Nimbus X2 software update (version 4.2) is paused while we investigate reports that some handsets won't restart. If your Nimbus X2 is stuck, hold the power and volume-down buttons for 20 seconds. Don't return the phone to a shop until you have tried this.

title: eSIM on the Corvid 5 and the Aster Fold
text: Kittiwake Mobile now supports eSIM on the Corvid 5 and the Aster Fold. Existing customers can switch in the app under Account, SIM. It takes about two minutes and doesn't change your number or your plan.

title: Scam texts asking for a release fee
text: Kittiwake will never text you a link asking for your PIN. Messages claiming your account is locked and asking you to pay a release fee are a scam. Forward them to 7726 and delete them.

title: Roaming in Europe from 1 December
text: From 1 December, roaming in Europe on Flex 20 and Flex 30 costs $2.00 a day, capped at $14.00 a month. Unlimited Plus keeps roaming at no extra charge.

title: Resetting your voicemail PIN
text: If you have forgotten your voicemail PIN, dial 121 from your Kittiwake phone and choose option 4. A new four-digit PIN arrives by text within a minute.

title: Kittiwake app version 7.3
text: The Kittiwake app version 7.3 adds a chart of data use by day and fixes a crash when opening bills on Android 15. Update it from your app store.

title: Error E42 when topping up
text: Some customers see error E42 when topping up with a card in the app. It means the card issuer declined the payment; try another card or top up at any Kittiwake shop.

title: Harbour Street shop closed for refurbishment
text: The Kittiwake shop on Harbour Street, Wrenmouth, closes for refurbishment from 3 to 17 November. The nearest open shop is on Fore Street, Saltmoor.

title: 5G live in Saltmoor and Port Ember
text: 5G is now live across Saltmoor and Port Ember. Customers with a 5G handset on any plan will see 5G in the status bar with no change needed.

title: 3G switch-off in Hollin Cross
text: Kittiwake is switching off its 3G network in Hollin Cross on 20 January. Older phones that only use 3G will stop making calls; check your handset under Settings, Mobile network.

title: New billing date for Family Share
text: Bills for Family Share accounts will be issued on the 5th of each month instead of the 28th, starting in February. Direct debits move automatically.

title: Wi-Fi calling on the Aster Fold
text: Wi-Fi calling is now available on the Aster Fold. Turn it on under Settings, Phone, Wi-Fi Calling; calls over Wi-Fi are free on every plan.

title: Outage in Tarnby after storm damage
text: Outage, 9:10 a.m.: customers in Tarnby have no mobile signal after storm damage to the mast on Cliff Lane. Engineers are on site and expect service back by evening.

title: Emergency calls work without signal
text: Emergency calls to 999 and 112 work on any network even if Kittiwake has no signal where you are. Your phone does not need credit or a SIM.

title: Pay As You Go credit lasts longer
text: Pay As You Go credit now lasts 12 months from your last top-up instead of 6. Credit you already have is extended automatically.

title: Kestrel Mini charger replacement
text: The Kestrel Mini charger sold between March and May may overheat. Stop using it and bring it to any Kittiwake shop for a free replacement; the phone itself is not affected.

title: Data rollover on Flex plans
text: Unused data on Flex 20 and Flex 30 now rolls over to the next month, up to 10 GB. Rolled-over data is used first.

title: Upgrading before your contract ends
text: Customers can upgrade their handset up to 60 days before their contract ends without a fee. Check your upgrade date in the app under Account, Plan.

title: Bringing your number to Kittiwake
text: Moving to Kittiwake with your old number? Text PAC to 65075 at your old provider, then give us the code. Your number moves within one working day.

title: Large print and Braille bills
text: Kittiwake now offers bills in large print and Braille at no charge. Ask in any shop or call 150 from your Kittiwake phone.

title: Coverage map shows indoor signal
text: The online coverage map at kittiwake.example/coverage now shows indoor and outdoor signal separately and is updated every Monday.

title: Billing system maintenance on 9 November
text: Our billing system will be unavailable on Sunday 9 November from midnight to 6 a.m. You can still make calls and use data, but you won't be able to view bills or top up.

title: Nuisance call filter
text: A new call filter labels suspected nuisance calls as Likely spam on screen. It is on by default; turn it off in the app under Settings, Calls.

title: More hotspot data on Unlimited Plus
text: Unlimited Plus now includes 20 GB of hotspot data a month, up from 10 GB.

title: Contract prices rise on 1 April
text: Monthly prices on all airtime contracts rise by $1.00 from 1 April, as set out in your contract terms. Pay As You Go prices do not change.

title: Lost or stolen phones
text: If your phone is lost or stolen, call 0300 555 0150 or use Report a lost phone in the app. We block the SIM straight away and can send a replacement the next day.

title: Protection against SIM swap fraud
text: To protect you from SIM swap fraud, a new SIM on your account now needs the one-time code we text to your existing number, or ID in a shop.

title: Mast upgrade at Eastholm Quay
text: New equipment at the Eastholm Quay mast will improve indoor signal around the harbour. Work runs overnight from 20 to 22 October, with short signal drops possible after midnight.

title: Corvid 5 update 2.8
text: Software update 2.8 for the Corvid 5 fixes blurry photos in low light and improves battery life. It installs overnight while the phone is charging.

title: Visual voicemail for Android
text: Visual voicemail is now available on Android phones. Download Kittiwake Voicemail from the app store and sign in with your Kittiwake number.

title: Student discount
text: Students in full-time education get 20 percent off Flex 20 and Flex 30. Verify your student status in the app to apply the discount from your next bill.

title: No more paper bill fee
text: We no longer charge $1.50 for paper bills. Customers who still receive paper bills will see the fee removed from November.

title: Marrowby shop opens on Sundays
text: The Marrowby shop now opens on Sundays from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.

title: Outage updates by text
text: Text HELP to 2020 to get a link to our status page and the latest outage updates by text.

title: World Calls add-on
text: The World Calls add-on gives 300 minutes to landlines in 40 countries for $5.00 a month. Add it in the app under Plan, Add-ons.

title: Nimbus X2 update 4.2.1 fixes restarts
text: Software update 4.2.1 for the Nimbus X2 is now available and fixes the restart problem that paused version 4.2. Charge the phone above 50 percent before installing.

title: When a direct debit fails
text: If a direct debit fails, we will try again after 7 days and text you before we do. There is no charge for the first failed payment.

title: Free signal booster
text: Customers with weak indoor signal can ask for a free Kittiwake signal booster, which plugs into your home broadband router.

title: Parental controls for Family Share
text: Parental controls in the app now let you block adult content and set a daily data limit for each number on a Family Share account.

title: Port Ember harbour festival
text: Extra mobile capacity will be in place for the Port Ember harbour festival from 12 to 14 July, so calls and data should keep working in the crowds.

title: Fibre works on Mill Road, Gullhaven
text: Roadworks for new fibre on Mill Road, Gullhaven, may cause short outages for customers on Kittiwake Home Broadband between 8 and 10 October.

title: Cancelling within 14 days
text: You can cancel a new contract within 14 days of receiving your phone for a full refund if the phone is returned unused.

title: When your monthly data runs out
text: Customers who use all their monthly data can keep browsing at 128 kbps at no charge until the next month begins, or buy a 5 GB boost for $4.00.

title: Relay calls are free
text: Relay UK calls for customers with hearing or speech difficulties are free from every Kittiwake plan: dial 18001 before the number.

title: Sign in with a passkey
text: The Kittiwake app now supports signing in with a passkey instead of a password. Set it up under Account, Security.
